LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Select your preferred language. Automatic detection uses your browser language or timezone.

STORAGE.TITLE: Storage
STORAGE.DESCRIPTION: Your data is currently stored in {{provider}}. To change the storage location, visit the Storage page. If you want to transfer your data, export it first, then switch storage and import it back.

PWA.TITLE: App
PWA.DESCRIPTION: Sky Planner can be installed as a PWA (Progressive Web App) on supported browsers, making it easier to access than a bookmark.

DAILY_CANDLES.TITLE: Daily candles
DAILY_CANDLES.DESCRIPTION: Enter a number to add regular candles to your Currency page when you complete your (season) daily quests on the Dashboard or Daily tracker. Set to 0 to disable.
DAILY_CANDLES.LABEL: Candles per daily check-in

SPIRIT_TREES.TITLE: Spirit trees
SPIRIT_TREES.CONNECTED_ON: All items leading up to the one you unlock will also be unlocked. Likewise, locking an item will lock the ones beyond it.
SPIRIT_TREES.CONNECTED_OFF: When you unlock an item only that item will be unlocked. You can choose to also unlock all preceding items.

ITEMS.TITLE: Items
ITEMS.DESCRIPTION: The Items page shows item details in a panel beside the list. Clicking an item shows it there instead of opening the item page. Only available on screens at least 1280 pixels wide.
ITEMS.BUTTON_SIDE_PANEL: Show item details in a side panel

DATE.TITLE: Date
DATE.DESCRIPTION: Change the date format. Today is {{date}}.

TIME.TITLE: Time
TIME.DESCRIPTION: Change the time format. It's now {{time}}.

THEME.TITLE: Theme
THEME.ADVANCED_DESC: Tweaks apply on top of the selected theme. Sliders you haven't moved follow the theme.

NAV.TITLE: Navigation
NAV.WIKI_NEW_TAB: Open Wiki links in a new tab

SHORTCUTS.TITLE: Shortcuts
SHORTCUTS.DESCRIPTION: Show quick keyboard shortcuts for fast navigation and search.

DEBUG.TITLE: Debug & Dev
DEBUG.DESCRIPTION: Adds debugging information to various pages. Only relevant if you actively contribute to the project.
DEBUG.COPY_COORDS_DESC: When enabled, clicking anywhere on a map copies the clicked [lat, lng] position to your clipboard.

NAV.DASHBOARD_CHECK_SEASON: I have done my season dailies
NAV.DASHBOARD_CHECK_DAILY: I have done my daily quests
NAV.DASHBOARD_CHECK_EVENT: I have collected my daily event currency
NAV.DASHBOARD_QUICK_START_DESC1: Add screenshots of your closet, or mark items by hand, and we'll work out which items, spirits and seasons you already have.
NAV.DASHBOARD_QUICK_START_DESC2: You can always find this option in Tools -> Quick start.
NAV.DASHBOARD_SEARCH_REFINE: Refine your search for more results.

DAILY.INTRO_1: Track your daily activities here. Don't forget to update your candles on the
DAILY.INTRO_3: Find more recurring events on the
DAILY.FIXED_NOTE: These activities always give the same amount of light. Tick them off as you do them; hide ones you skip.
DAILY.VARIABLE_NOTE: These activities aren't available every day or don't always give the same amount of light.
DAILY.TIMED_NOTE: These activities are available for a limited time on a repeating schedule.

CURRENCY.TITLE: In-game currency
CURRENCY.INTRO: Keep track of your in-game currencies. These values change automatically when you unlock items, check in your dailies, or use the calculator.
CURRENCY.CONVERTED_DESC: You had leftover season candles from the previous season. These have been converted into regular currencies.
CURRENCY.SPENT_INTRO_1: This page shows the total amount of currencies you have spent on items in Sky.
CURRENCY.SPENT_INTRO_2: Items that specifically belong to a season, such as those from season spirits and guides, will be shown in the Seasons section. Items that are not directly related to a season, such as items from the Nesting Workshop, will be shown in the Regular section.
CURRENCY.SPENT_INTRO_3: In the breakdown the following abbreviations are used: (c) for candles, (h) for hearts, (ac) for ascended candles, (ec) for event currency, (lp) for loyalty points, (sc) for season candles, and (sh) for season hearts.

SPIRITS_PAGE.TITLE: Spirits
SPIRITS_PAGE.ELUSIVE_HINT_1:
On this page you can find the most elusive season spirits. The spirits that have been missing for the longest time are shown at the top.
Please keep in mind that traveling spirit visits are mostly random, so use this data at your own discretion.
SPIRITS_PAGE.ELUSIVE_HINT_2: A graph version of this data is available on the Graphs - Spirits page.
